title: Delhi coach Dahiya demands accountability, backs Badoni to lead from front
description:
Vijay Dahiya wants Delhi's players to take ownership of the team's fortunes as they begin their Ranji Trophy campaign against Bengal, with the head coach stressing that individual talent must translate into collective success.
Delhi have struggled to do well as a team despite producing standout individual performances, and Dahiya believes self-belief, responsibility and pride in representing the state are key to improving their red-ball fortunes.
"It's an honour to come back and be part of this group, which excites me," Dahiya told PTI, after taking over as Delhi's head coach for the third time.
Dahiya, who has followed domestic cricket closely as a commentator, believes the players need to take the initiative rather than wait for others to turn things around.
"We do need a turnaround in red-ball cricket, and the players need to understand what the format requires," he said.
